$comment: Block definitions of the built-in `dwell` namespace (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md). Run `node shared/blocks/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if the generated files are stale. Blocks take runtime state ids in this order, each block's states in property order (keys alphabetical, the last key varying fastest, values in declared order). Air must come first (id 0). `fluids` are the named fluid looks (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, 'Fluid looks') that blocks with `"look": "fluid"` reference by name; a fluid block's opacity is its fluid's. The content is prototype (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).
$rampFamilies: Half-height grid (Phase 41, docs/HALF_HEIGHT_GRID.md): each listed natural block gets `<name>_ramp[facing, flooded, half, shape]`, the stored cardinal ramps the generator places (shape ramp, steep_lower, steep_upper). Natural blocks are not adaptive on this grid: shapes are chosen once, at generation. Their `flooded` (as on main) marks a block the sea's water stands in: a ramp below sea level holds it in its open part (WATER_RENDERING.md §9).
$lights: Light sources (docs/LIGHTS.md §2): the dynamic point lights that blocks reference by name (`light`), held in a hand or placed. color (sRGB), strength (its irradiance at the flame), radiusM (where it ends; a placed torch's block light reaches `emits` metres, so the same radius lights alike), flicker (amount: the share of its strength it takes at most; speed: its noise's cycles a second), shadows (whether it may cast them, the Torch shadows setting's, Phase 47 T2), flame (optional: the flame look drawn where it burns, a name in shared/look/flames.json; docs/LIGHTS.md §6). A placed block's flood light is its `emits`; a held one never touches the flood light.

blocks.$comment: sideUnder: a dirt side face with grass directly above (a grass slope's low side at a step or cliff) shows the turf's skirt hanging over its top edge (docs/PAINTERLY_TEXTURES.md §2).

blocks.name: water
blocks.$lightFilter: Flood light (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11): each ½ m of water takes a level off the sky light under it.

blocks.$comment: The structure sandbox's ground (prototype, docs/STRUCTURES.md §7.6): white with a faint line at every block edge (the `grid` tile) and a stronger one every 8 blocks (the `grid` look option), not in the palette, and indestructible so it can always be built on. Not adaptive: it stays flat cubes.
blocks.name: sandbox_floor

blocks.$comment: Drawn cutout: the leaves tile has transparent gaps between the leaves. lightFilter: a canopy dims the sky light under it rather than shutting it out (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11).
blocks.name: leaves

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/TRANSPARENT_BLOCKS.md §6): blades of grass, the first plant. No collision; crossed quads drawn cutout, jittered per cell, swaying in the wind and fading out before the LOD; placed by hand only (world generation doesn't grow it), on grass or dirt, replaced by what is placed into it, and gone with the block under it.
blocks.name: tall_grass

blocks.$comment: The stored ramps (rampFamilies) at their own slots, as generated before the torch was added: blocks added after them keep every earlier state id (the worldgen goldens hash ids).
blocks.name: stone_ramp

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/LIGHTS.md): a torch on the floor, 1 m tall over two ½ m cells. This is its lower cell (the stick), placed from the palette; `extends.up` puts `dwell:torch_upper` (the flame) in the cell above, and breaking either cell clears both (BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, Multi-cell blocks). Crossed quads, drawn cutout, no collision, standing on the block below and gone with it. Its `light` is the light a hand holding it gives off; a hand holding it shows the `torch` item (shared/characters).
blocks.name: torch

blocks.$comment: The torch's upper cell (docs/LIGHTS.md): the stick's top and the flame, which gives off the block light (`emits` 14, its cell the flame's) and, with Torch shadows (T2), the placed torch's dynamic light. Placed only with its torch (`partOf`).
blocks.name: torch_upper
